TITUS version

by Jost Gippert,
Frankfurt a/M, 28.2.1998 / 20.6.1998 / 1.6.2000 / 1.9.2002



In order to provide a common retrieval basis for inscriptions that are written in different scripts, a unified Latin transliteration has been added throughout.
Direction of writing has not yet been checked (right-to-left is assumed throughout for inscriptions in Oscan and Umbrian scripts). In the HTML edition, left-to-right direction cannot yet be displayed.
